title: Best Gyms in New Plymouth 2026 — Prices & Reviews
meta_desc: Best gyms in New Plymouth 2026. Honest prices and reviews for City Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Snap Fitness, local gyms and fitness centres in New Plymouth.
intro: New Plymouth has a compact but well-served gym market. City Fitness, Anytime Fitness, and Snap Fitness all operate in the city, providing 24/7 access at competitive prices. New Plymouth has a notably active outdoor culture — many residents supplement gym training with surfing, mountain biking, or running on the Coastal Walkway — so gyms here tend to attract serious, consistent members rather than casual visitors.

sections.heading: City Fitness New Plymouth
sections.body: City Fitness New Plymouth is the budget standout at $7.99/week — no long-term lock-in, 24/7 access, and a full range of weights and cardio equipment. For anyone who just wants to train without paying premium prices, this is the clear value choice. The joining fee of $29 is regularly waived during promotions. The Black Card ($14.99/week) is worth considering if you travel to other NZ cities regularly, as it includes multi-club access nationwide.

sections.heading: Anytime Fitness New Plymouth
sections.body: Anytime Fitness has a strong presence in New Plymouth. The 24/7 access and nationwide reciprocal rights make it popular with people who travel for work. At $16.95/week on a 12-month contract, it's mid-priced but the club consistency and network access justify the premium over City Fitness for frequent travellers. Equipment standard is reliable.

sections.heading: Snap Fitness New Plymouth
sections.body: Snap Fitness New Plymouth offers 24/7 access at $14.95/week — similar to Jetts on price, with varying contract lengths depending on the membership tier. A good alternative if Anytime Fitness feels too expensive or City Fitness too basic. Contract terms vary by location — ask before signing.

sections.heading: Local and Independent Gyms
sections.body: New Plymouth has a strong independent gym scene. Several locally-owned gyms and CrossFit boxes operate in the city and offer personal training, group classes, and a more community-focused environment. Prices typically range from $15–$25/week and include coaching that the chain gyms don't provide. Worth exploring if you want structured programming alongside your training.

sections.heading: New Plymouth Gym Tips
list: City Fitness joining fee ($29) is frequently waived — check before paying
Jetts has no joining fee — zero upfront cost to start training
Anytime Fitness is best for people who travel between NZ cities regularly
New Plymouth doesn't have a Les Mills — independent studios and ClassPass fill the group fitness gap
Local independent gyms often have better coaching than the chains for similar prices
The Coastal Walkway, Pouakai Range, and beaches mean many New Plymouth residents use gyms as a supplement to outdoor training — a shorter, cheaper membership may suit you

sections.heading: Which New Plymouth Gym Is Right for You?
sections.body: For value, City Fitness at $7.99/week is the obvious answer — 24/7, no lock-in, cheap. For those who travel frequently, Anytime Fitness' nationwide network justifies the price difference. For zero upfront cost with maximum flexibility, Jetts is the easiest start. If you want coaching and community, one of New Plymouth's independent gyms is worth considering over any chain.

faq.question: What is the cheapest gym in New Plymouth?
faq.answer: City Fitness Basic is the cheapest gym in New Plymouth at $7.99/week with 24/7 access and no long-term lock-in. Jetts offers $14.95/week with no joining fee and no lock-in.

faq.question: Does New Plymouth have a Les Mills gym?
faq.answer: No — New Plymouth doesn't currently have a Les Mills. The closest Les Mills clubs are in Hamilton or Wellington. Residents wanting group fitness classes have independent studios and ClassPass as alternatives.

faq.question: Are there 24/7 gyms in New Plymouth?
faq.answer: Yes — City Fitness, Snap Fitness, Anytime Fitness, and Jetts all offer 24/7 access in New Plymouth.
